About Us

Solomon Industries LLC specializes in high-quality industrial materials, delivering innovative solutions for manufacturing and construction. With expertise in metal casting, fabrication, ground screws, quartz stone, rubber, and plywood, we provide durable and efficient materials that power industries worldwide. Our commitment to excellence ensures reliable products for structural, mechanical, and industrial applications.

Core Values

With a vision for the future and a commitment to continuous improvement, we provide high-quality industrial materials with innovation, sustainability, and reliability at our core.

Innovation

We are constantly pushing boundaries to develop cutting-edge solutions in metal fabrication, ground screws, quartz stone, rubber, and plywood. Our commitment to innovation ensures that industries receive the most advanced and efficient materials.

Quality

Excellence and reliability define our products. We adhere to the highest standards to deliver durable, high-performance materials that meet the evolving demands of the industrial sector.

Expert Consulting

We go beyond supplying materials—we act as trusted partners, understanding our clients' needs and offering expert guidance to help them choose the best solutions for their projects.

Sustainability

Committed to responsible manufacturing, we prioritize sustainable materials and eco-friendly practices to reduce environmental impact while delivering top-tier industrial solutions.

Partnership

Success is built on collaboration. We foster strong, long-term relationships with clients, suppliers, and industry partners to drive mutual growth and innovation.
